H1: Operator can run a read-only, no-person-data CLI that prints aggregated audit counters only, and returns a nonzero exit for corrupt/missing/unreviewed captures, without exposing file paths/URLs/records.
H0: The CLI may silently return success for integrity failures or leak private data in errors.
tests: clean fictional manifest+review => exit 0 JSON no raw source paths/URLs
tampered SHA => exit 2, summary counters only
bad symlink/missing root => exit 2 with generic error only
no network or HTTP server route
acceptance: Actual subprocess tests, no claims of person identity or source publisher signature.
